title: fix(service-automation): try_catch Error Variable help describes the caught error in words
body:
Fixes #24576

Clause-②: no

The Error Variable help the Studio flow inspector shows for a Try / Catch node no longer names a TypeScript type. The text is the `try_catch` descriptor's own `errorVariable` description (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/try-catch-node.ts`, `configSchema`); this PR rewrites that one string in words and adds a patch changeset for `@objectstack/service-automation`.

New text, as served by the descriptor:

> Variable holding the caught error in the catch region (default `$error`, read as `{{ $error.message }}`). It carries the id of this Try / Catch node (`nodeId`), the failure message, which normally names the step that failed (`message`), the platform error code when that step reported one (`code`), and, when the failure happened inside a loop, the zero-based pass number (`iteration`) and the item being processed (`item`)

## What the engine really binds (measured before writing)

A throwaway probe on the real `AutomationEngine` (probe file deleted, not committed) ran a `try_catch` whose try region holds one failing step `push_step`, and printed `$error` from the catch region:

| case | bound value |
| --- | --- |
| step returns a plain failure | `nodeId: guard`, `message: Node 'push_step' failed: boom` |
| step returns a failure carrying `DUPLICATE_RECORD` | the same, plus `code: DUPLICATE_RECORD` |
| the same inside a loop | plus `iteration: 0`, `item: { id: 'r1' }` |

Two consequences for the wording:

- `nodeId` is the Try / Catch node's own id (`guard`), not the failing inner step (`push_step`). The inner step is named inside `message`. The help therefore says "the id of this Try / Catch node" and "the failure message, which normally names the step that failed", and does not say "the failing node" as the triage comment words it.
- The old text left out `code`, which the engine has bound for a while; the new text names it, so an author learns a catch region can branch on it.

## Verification

- Premise: on `origin/main` `7c7741dcb` line 75 of `try-catch-node.ts` names the type, as the card says.
- Served text read through `engine.getActionDescriptor('try_catch')`: a PascalCase identifier scan returns null on the new text and `TryCatchErrorValue` on the old text (control leg).
- `@objectstack/service-automation`: `tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck` exit 0; full suite 193 files / 2580 tests passed (run at `f967f573b`, under the shared verify lock).
- Gates: the 59 families `dispatch-gates --commands` derives for this diff were run; 58 exit 0 and the `--ran` reconciliation reads 59 accounted, 0 unrun. One is NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (prerequisite not met, it needs every workspace package's `dist/` and only the service-automation closure was built); CI's `Build Core` hosts it.

## Acceptance notes

- No test added. Nothing pins the `try_catch` descriptor's help text (the closest pins, `notify-node.test.ts` and `http-nodes.test.ts`, are for other nodes); the change is one string and the existing suite stays green.
- `packages/spec/**` is untouched. The spec's own `errorVariable` describe still says "The value is a `TryCatchErrorValue`"; the surfaces that describe reaches are listed in the report comment on #24576 for the seat to file.
- Not browser-verified: the inspector's help slot was not driven in a browser. Sibling descriptors (`notify`, `screen`) already carry `{{ }}` examples in help text.
